metadata.description: Breakpoint 2026 is Solana's flagship conference at Olympia London, November 15–17. Builders, institutions, and policymakers shaping Internet Capital Markets.
metadata.ogTitle: Breakpoint 2026 — Solana's flagship conference in London

narrative.eyebrow: The future of money, in the city that invented modern finance.
narrative.body1: Over the past year, Solana has seen major institutional and regulatory momentum—from J.P. Morgan and Goldman Sachs to SEC classification—alongside $650B in monthly stablecoin settlement.
narrative.body2: Breakpoint 2026 convenes builders, institutions, and policymakers in London to shape the future of internet capital markets.

q1.question: Where is Breakpoint located this year?
q1.answer: Breakpoint 2026 will take place at Olympia Convention Centre in London.

q2.question: What is included in my Breakpoint ticket?
q2.answer: Your ticket includes access to main conference programming, networking areas, and on-site experiences. Food and beverages will be available on-site, along with Breakpoint merch.

q3.question: Are tickets refundable?
q3.answer: Tickets are non-refundable but are transferable.

q4.question: How can I apply to speak at Breakpoint?
q4.answer: Speaker applications are not open yet. More information will be shared in the coming months.

q5.question: How can I sponsor Breakpoint?
q5.answer: If you're interested in sponsoring Breakpoint, submit your details <link>here</link> and the team will follow up with available opportunities.
